ruleDefinitions.name: File With Uncommon Extension Created By An Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of files with an executable or script extension by an Office application.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msaccess\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\visio\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cmd$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.com$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ocx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.proj$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scf$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sys$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wsf$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wsh$"))) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\assembly\\\\tmp\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$"))) AND  NOT (((file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\WebServiceCache\\\\AllUsers.*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.com$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\webexdelta\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$"))))
